name: socksoverrdp-server-node
description: Experimental Node.js server-side port of SocksOverRDP.

scripts.test:helpers: node -e "const s=require('./server'); const data=s.encodeFrame({connectionId:1,payload:Buffer.from('ok'),close:true}); const out=s.decodeFrames(data); if(out.frames.length!==1||out.leftover.length||!out.frames[0].close) process.exit(1);"
